page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 18 Gbps. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance highly specialized for compute-bound workloads rather than memory-intensive tasks.

Given its high-frequency Intel Xeon processor and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfc9i.6xlarge is engineered for workloads requiring significant raw processing power. Appropriate use cases include high-performance web serving, batch processing, compute-heavy CI/CD pipelines, and distributed analytics where CPU performance is prioritized over large memory footprints.
